## Pull request overview

This PR fixes ES module directory import errors that were causing CI failures during the coverage step. The issue arose because TypeScript's wildcard type exports were compiling to directory imports without file extensions, which ES modules don't support.

**Changes:**
- Replaced wildcard type export with explicit named exports in `packages/core/src/index.ts`
- Added `.js` file extension to avoid directory import in `packages/core/src/validation/index.ts`
- Added `pretest:coverage` script to ensure packages build before coverage runs

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 3 out of 4 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/core/src/index.ts | Changed from wildcard type export to explicit named exports (SchemaNode, ComponentRendererProps) to avoid directory imports |
| packages/core/src/validation/index.ts | Added `/index.js` file extension to validators export to resolve directory import |
| package.json | Added pretest:coverage script mirroring the existing pretest pattern to ensure builds complete before coverage tests |
